type binReuseEntry struct {
key [5]uint64
index int32
valid bool
}

func (m *Module) BinReuseConfigure(capacity int) {
if capacity<1 || capacity>256 || capacity&(capacity-1)!=0 {panic("invalid diagnostic capacity")}
m.binReuse = make([]binReuseEntry, capacity)
}

func binReuseSlot(bits uint64, capacity int) uint64 {
if capacity==1 { return 0 }
bits ^= bits>>33
bits *= 0xff51afd7ed558ccd
bits ^= bits>>33
return bits & uint64(capacity-1)
}

func (m *Module) BinReuseOccupied(value float64) bool {
return m.binReuse[binReuseSlot(math.Float64bits(value),len(m.binReuse))].valid
}

func (m *Module) BinReuseContains(value float64, parameters [4]uint64) bool {
key := [5]uint64{math.Float64bits(value),parameters[0],parameters[1],parameters[2],parameters[3]}
entry := &m.binReuse[binReuseSlot(key[0],len(m.binReuse))]
return entry.valid && entry.key==key
}

func (m *Module) BinReuseCachedMapping(value float64, parameters [4]uint64) int32 {
key := [5]uint64{math.Float64bits(value),parameters[0],parameters[1],parameters[2],parameters[3]}
entry := &m.binReuse[binReuseSlot(key[0],len(m.binReuse))]
if entry.valid && entry.key==key {return entry.index}
index := m.BinReuseOriginalMapping(value, parameters)
*entry = binReuseEntry{key:key,index:index,valid:true}
return index
}

// Diagnostic-only extraction from the pinned translated module, not a host ln.
func (m *Module) BinReuseOriginalMapping(v2 float64, parameters [4]uint64) int32 {
var v1, v6, v7 int32
var v16, v17 float64
var v19, v20 int64
	t16 := math.Float64frombits(parameters[1])
	var p17 float64
	{
		var p18 int32
		{
			v19 = int64(math.Float64bits(v2))
			if v19 >= i64(0x10000000000000) {
				if uint64(v19) > uint64(i64(0x7fefffffffffffff)) {
					goto l3
				}
				v1 = i32(-1023)
				v20 = int64(uint64(v19) >> 32)
				if v20 != i64(0x3ff00000) {
					t19 := int32(v20)
					p18 = t19
					goto l4
				}
				if int32(v19) != 0 {
					p18 = i32(0x3ff00000)
					goto l4
				}
				p17 = float64(0)
				goto l5
			}
			t20 := float64(float64(-1) / float64(v2*v2))
			if v2 == float64(0) {
				p17 = t20
				goto l5
			}
			if v19 < i64(0) {
				goto l6
			}
			v1 = i32(-1077)
			v19 = int64(math.Float64bits(float64(v2 * float64(0x1p+54))))
			p18 = int32(int64(uint64(v19) >> 32))
		}
	l4:
		v6 = p18 + i32(614242)
		v16 = float64(int32(uint32(v6)>>20) + v1)
		t21 := float64(v16 * float64(0x1.62e42feep-01))
		v2 = float64(math.Float64frombits(uint64(v19&i64(0xffffffff)|int64(uint32(v6&i32(0xfffff)+i32(1072079006)))<<32)) + float64(-1))
		t22 := v2
		t23 := float64(v16 * float64(0x1.a39ef35793c76p-33))
		v16 = float64(v2 / float64(v2+float64(2)))
		t24 := v16
		v17 = float64(v2 * float64(v2*float64(0.5)))
		t25 := v17
		v16 = float64(v16 * v16)
		v2 = float64(v16 * v16)
		t26 := float64(t21 + float64(t22+float64(float64(t23+float64(t24*float64(t25+float64(float64(v2*float64(float64(v2*float64(float64(v2*float64(0.15313837699209373))+float64(0.22222198432149784)))+float64(0.3999999999940942)))+float64(v16*float64(float64(v2*float64(float64(v2*float64(float64(v2*float64(0.14798198605116586))+float64(0.1818357216161805)))+float64(0.2857142874366239)))+float64(0.6666666666666735)))))))-v17)))
		p17 = t26
		goto l5
	}
l6:
	v2 = float64(float64(v2-v2) / float64(0))
l3:
	p17 = v2
l5:
	t27 := math.Float64frombits(parameters[3])
	v7 = i32_trunc_sat_f64_s(math.Floor(float64(float64(t16*p17) + t27)))
return v7
}

type binReuseEntry struct {
key [5]uint64
index int32
valid bool
}

func (m *Module) BinReuseConfigure(capacity int) {
if capacity<1 || capacity>256 || capacity&(capacity-1)!=0 {panic("invalid diagnostic capacity")}
m.binReuse = make([]binReuseEntry, capacity)
}

func binReuseSlot(bits uint64, capacity int) uint64 {
if capacity==1 { return 0 }
bits ^= bits>>33
bits *= 0xff51afd7ed558ccd
bits ^= bits>>33
return bits & uint64(capacity-1)
}

func (m *Module) BinReuseOccupied(value float64) bool {
return m.binReuse[binReuseSlot(math.Float64bits(value),len(m.binReuse))].valid
}

func (m *Module) BinReuseContains(value float64, parameters [4]uint64) bool {
key := [5]uint64{math.Float64bits(value),parameters[0],parameters[1],parameters[2],parameters[3]}
entry := &m.binReuse[binReuseSlot(key[0],len(m.binReuse))]

}

func (m *Module) BinReuseCachedMapping(value float64, parameters [4]uint64) int32 {

paths=[out/(role+'.test') for role in roles]+[out/'stream.test']

def sample(roundname, family, role, query, n, duration):

 args=[str(binary),'-test.run=^$','-test.bench='+query,'-test.benchtime='+duration,'-test.count=1','-test.benchmem']
 result=subprocess.run(args,env=env,text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
 rows=[line for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith('Benchmark')]
 assert len(rows)==1,(family,role,query,result.stdout)
 if family in ['new','mapping','matched','stream']:
  fields=rows[0].split();actual=float(fields[fields.index('actual-procs')-1])
  assert actual==(16 if family=='stream' else 1),rows[0]
 with (out/(roundname+'-'+family+'-'+role+'.txt')).open('a') as log:
  print('ROUND',n,datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),file=log)
  print('COMMAND',json.dumps(args),file=log)

 table={}

  for role in available:
   path=out/(roundname+'-'+family+'-'+role+'.txt'); data=path.read_text()
   normalized=data.replace('pkg: cocoon.dev/cocoon/dd','pkg: dario.cat/cocoon/examples/datadog/go/dd')
   comparison=out/(roundname+'-'+family+'-'+role+'-normalized.txt');comparison.write_text(normalized)
   for line in data.splitlines():
    if not line.startswith('Benchmark'):continue
    fields=line.split();name=fields[0];metrics={fields[i]:float(fields[i-1]) for i in range(3,len(fields),2)}
    row=table.setdefault(name,{}).setdefault(role,{'ns':[],'metrics':{}})
    row['ns'].append(metrics['ns/op'])
    for key,value in metrics.items():row['metrics'].setdefault(key,[]).append(value)
  if family in ['new','original','matched']:
   args=['/home/dario/go/bin/benchstat',*[str(out/(roundname+'-'+family+'-'+role+'-normalized.txt')) for role in roles]]
   for suffix,fmt in [('benchstat.txt',[]),('benchstat.csv',['-format=csv'])]:

 for name,row in table.items():
  for role,values in row.items():
   assert len(values['ns'])==7,(roundname,name,role,values['ns'])
   values['median_ns']=statistics.median(values['ns'])
   values['median_metrics']={k:statistics.median(v) for k,v in values['metrics'].items()}
   if 'untouched' in row:values['delta_percent']=100*(values['median_ns']/statistics.median(row['untouched']['ns'])-1)
 summary[roundname]=table

for name,row in summary['confirm'].items():

===== .cache/bin-reuse/reference-bin-reuse_test.go SHA256 d5f93c5ea4242533303416476b94172ce0c4866fe2f80024c56934fe32f4c97b =====
package dd

import (
	"math"
	"runtime"
	"testing"
)

const binReuseCorpusSize = 8192

var binReuseCorpora = []string{"Repeated", "UniqueCycle", "NearbyUniqueCycle", "MostlyUniqueCycle", "Phases", "BroadHoldout", "NegativeBins"}

// Freeze these inputs before selecting a cache. All finite corpora repeat after
// 8,192 points in timed loops; the separate Increasing control never repeats.
func binReuseValues(corpus string) []float64 {
	values := make([]float64, binReuseCorpusSize)
	negative := negativeBinSketchValues()
	for index := range values {
		switch corpus {
		case "Repeated":
			values[index] = 42
		case "UniqueCycle":
			values[index] = float64(index + 1)
		case "NearbyUniqueCycle":
			values[index] = math.Float64frombits(math.Float64bits(42) + uint64(index)) // #nosec G115 -- The index is bounded by the corpus size.
		case "MostlyUniqueCycle":
			values[index] = float64(1_000_000 + index)
			if index%16 == 0 {
				values[index] = 42
			}
		case "Phases":
			values[index] = float64(1_000_000 + index)
			if index/1024%2 == 0 {
				values[index] = float64(40 + index%16)
			}
		case "BroadHoldout":
			// An odd multiplier permutes the 52-bit mantissa; unique indices
			// cannot repeat a value even when their exponents coincide.
			mantissa := uint64(index+1) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15 & ((1 << 52) - 1) // #nosec G115 -- The index is positive and bounded.
			exponent := uint64(723 + index*37%601)                             // #nosec G115 -- Exponents are in [723, 1323].
			values[index] = math.Float64frombits(exponent<<52 | mantissa)
		case "NegativeBins":
			values[index] = negative[index%len(negative)]
		default:
			panic("unknown bin-reuse corpus")
		}
	}
	return values
}

func BenchmarkSketchBinReuse(b *testing.B) {
	for _, corpus := range append([]string{"Increasing"}, binReuseCorpora...) {
		b.Run(corpus, func(b *testing.B) {
			batchingProcessors(b, 1)
			sketch, _ := benchmarkSketch(b)
			values := binReuseValues("UniqueCycle")
			if corpus != "Increasing" {
				values = binReuseValues(corpus)
			}
			// Warm the store with one corpus, including collapse for the
			// broad holdout. UniqueCycle stresses the cache capacity.
			for _, value := range values {
				if err := sketch.Add(value); err != nil {
					b.Fatal(err)
				}
			}
			index := 0
			before := 0
			b.ReportAllocs()
			b.ResetTimer()
			for b.Loop() {
				value := values[index&(binReuseCorpusSize-1)]
				if corpus == "Increasing" {
					value = float64(binReuseCorpusSize + index + 1)
				}
				if err := sketch.Add(value); err != nil {
					b.Fatal(err)
				}
				index++
			}
			b.StopTimer()
			batchingMetrics(b, 1, 1, before, 0)
			if count, err := sketch.Count(); err != nil || count != float64(b.N+len(values)) {
				b.Fatalf("count=%g, want=%d: %v", count, b.N+len(values), err)
			}
		})
	}
}


func benchmarkSketch(b *testing.B) (*Sketch, int64) {
 b.Helper();library:=open(b);sketch,err:=library.NewSketch();if err!=nil {b.Fatal(err)}
 b.Cleanup(func(){if err:=sketch.Close();err!=nil {b.Error(err)}});return sketch,0
}
func batchingProcessors(b *testing.B, processors int) {
 b.Helper();previous:=runtime.GOMAXPROCS(processors);b.Cleanup(func(){runtime.GOMAXPROCS(previous)})
 if runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0)!=processors {b.Fatal("actual processor mismatch")}
}
func batchingMetrics(b *testing.B, points, processors, before, after int) {
 b.Helper();if runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0)!=processors {b.Fatal("actual processor mismatch")}
 b.ReportMetric(float64(processors),"actual-procs");b.ReportMetric(float64(points),"points/op")
 b.ReportMetric(float64(points)*float64(b.N)/b.Elapsed().Seconds(),"points/s")
}

package dd

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

// These varied inputs are held out from the PGO training benchmarks.
func variedSketchValues() [16]float64 {
	return [16]float64{
		0.01, 0.025, 0.125, 0.5,
		1.25, 3.75, 12.5, 42.25,
		100.5, 512, 1024.75, 8192,
		10000.25, 65536, 250000.5, 1000000,
	}
}

func variedSQLQueries() [8]string {
	return [8]string{
		"SELECT sku, price FROM catalog WHERE category = 'garden' AND price > 19.95",
		"SELECT shipment_id FROM shipments WHERE destination IN ('Oslo', 'Porto') AND priority = 3",
		"INSERT INTO audit_events (actor, action, sequence_no) VALUES ('operator-a', 'login', 8127)",
		"INSERT INTO stock_levels (sku, available) VALUES ('widget-42', 96)",
		"UPDATE invoices SET paid = true, memo = 'wire-transfer' WHERE invoice_no = 7351",
		"UPDATE inventory SET quantity = quantity - 7 WHERE location = 'north-bin' AND product_id = 643",
		"DELETE FROM sessions WHERE account_id = 902 AND token = 'expired-token'",
		"DELETE FROM temp_readings WHERE station = 'ridge' AND recorded_at < '2026-01-01'",
	}
}

func BenchmarkSketchAddVaried(b *testing.B) {
	library := open(b)
	sketch, err := library.NewSketch()
	if err != nil {
		b.Fatal(err)
	}
	b.Cleanup(func() {
		if closeErr := sketch.Close(); closeErr != nil {
			b.Error(closeErr)
		}
	})
	values := variedSketchValues()
	index := 0
	b.ReportAllocs()
	b.ResetTimer()
	for b.Loop() {
		if addErr := sketch.Add(values[index]); addErr != nil {
			b.Fatal(addErr)
		}
		index = (index + 1) % len(values)
	}
	b.StopTimer()
	if count, countErr := sketch.Count(); countErr != nil || count != float64(b.N) {
		b.Fatalf("point count = %g, want %d: %v", count, b.N, countErr)
	}
}

func BenchmarkObfuscateSQLVaried(b *testing.B) {
	library := open(b)
	queries := variedSQLQueries()
	index := 0
	b.ReportAllocs()
	b.ResetTimer()
	for b.Loop() {
		output, err := library.ObfuscateSQL(b.Context(), queries[index])
		if err != nil || output == "" {
			b.Fatalf("query %d produced %q: %v", index, output, err)
		}
		index = (index + 1) % len(queries)
	}
}

func TestVariedBenchmarkCorpus(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	library := open(t)
	sketch, err := library.NewSketch()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if closeErr := sketch.Close(); closeErr != nil {
			t.Error(closeErr)
		}
	})
	values := variedSketchValues()
	for index, value := range values {
		if addErr := sketch.Add(value); addErr != nil {
			t.Fatalf("value %d rejected: %v", index, addErr)
		}
	}
	if count, countErr := sketch.Count(); countErr != nil || count != float64(len(values)) {
		t.Fatalf("point count = %g, want %d: %v", count, len(values), countErr)
	}
	for index, query := range variedSQLQueries() {
		output, sqlErr := library.ObfuscateSQL(t.Context(), query)
		if sqlErr != nil || !strings.Contains(output, "?") {
			t.Fatalf("query %d produced %q: %v", index, output, sqlErr)
		}
	}
}

===== .cache/bin-reuse/reference-matched_test.go SHA256 3255ce2b841519c711a134f686407413482226b17a1ad956fbf3393111f92718 =====
package dd
import ("fmt";"math";"runtime";"testing")
func batchingValues(corpus string, size int) []float64 {
	values := make([]float64, size)
	negative := negativeBinSketchValues()
	for index := range values {
		switch corpus {
		case "Repeated":
			values[index] = 42
		case "Nearby":
			values[index] = 1 + float64(index)/float64(max(size, 1))
		case "Unique":
			values[index] = float64(index + 1)
		case "NegativeBins":
			values[index] = negative[index%len(negative)]
		case "Holdout":
			// Deterministic, nonmonotonic, broad exponents and varied mantissas.
			values[index] = math.Ldexp(1+float64((index*7919+104729)%65521)/65521, index%601-300)
		}
	}
	return values
}


func BenchmarkSketchMatchedBatch(b *testing.B) {
for _,corpus:=range []string{"Repeated","Nearby","Unique","NegativeBins","Holdout"} {
for _,size:=range []int{1,32,1024,8192} {
for _,mode:=range []string{"Scalar","Facade"} {
b.Run(fmt.Sprintf("%s/N%d/%s",corpus,size,mode),func(b *testing.B){
previous:=runtime.GOMAXPROCS(1);b.Cleanup(func(){runtime.GOMAXPROCS(previous)})
library:=open(b);sketch,err:=library.NewSketch();if err!=nil{b.Fatal(err)}
b.Cleanup(func(){if err:=sketch.Close();err!=nil{b.Error(err)}})
values:=batchingValues(corpus,size)
add:=sketch.AddMany
if mode=="Scalar" {add=func(vs []float64)error{for _,v:=range vs{if err:=sketch.Add(v);err!=nil{return err}};return nil}}
if err:=add(values);err!=nil{b.Fatal(err)}
b.ReportAllocs();b.ResetTimer()
for b.Loop(){if err:=add(values);err!=nil{b.Fatal(err)}}
b.StopTimer()
if runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0)!=1{b.Fatal("actual processor mismatch")}
b.ReportMetric(1,"actual-procs");b.ReportMetric(float64(size),"points/op")
b.ReportMetric(float64(size)*float64(b.N)/b.Elapsed().Seconds(),"points/s")
if count,err:=sketch.Count();err!=nil||count!=float64(size)*float64(b.N+1){b.Fatal("count mismatch",count,err)}
})
}}}}

===== examples/datadog/go/dd/bin_reuse_bench_test.go SHA256 aee2461dbc412268372a620863600f95bb6c3e6ab3cc934d6c4a7e514d73de2a =====
package dd

import (
	"math"
	"runtime"
	"testing"
)

const binReuseCorpusSize = 8192

var binReuseCorpora = []string{"Repeated", "UniqueCycle", "NearbyUniqueCycle", "MostlyUniqueCycle", "Phases", "BroadHoldout", "NegativeBins"}

// Freeze these inputs before selecting a cache. All finite corpora repeat after
// 8,192 points in timed loops; the separate Increasing control never repeats.
func binReuseValues(corpus string) []float64 {
	values := make([]float64, binReuseCorpusSize)
	negative := negativeBinSketchValues()
	for index := range values {
		switch corpus {
		case "Repeated":
			values[index] = 42
		case "UniqueCycle":
			values[index] = float64(index + 1)
		case "NearbyUniqueCycle":
			values[index] = math.Float64frombits(math.Float64bits(42) + uint64(index)) // #nosec G115 -- The index is bounded by the corpus size.
		case "MostlyUniqueCycle":
			values[index] = float64(1_000_000 + index)
			if index%16 == 0 {
				values[index] = 42
			}
		case "Phases":
			values[index] = float64(1_000_000 + index)
			if index/1024%2 == 0 {
				values[index] = float64(40 + index%16)
			}
		case "BroadHoldout":
			// An odd multiplier permutes the 52-bit mantissa; unique indices
			// cannot repeat a value even when their exponents coincide.
			mantissa := uint64(index+1) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15 & ((1 << 52) - 1) // #nosec G115 -- The index is positive and bounded.
			exponent := uint64(723 + index*37%601)                             // #nosec G115 -- Exponents are in [723, 1323].
			values[index] = math.Float64frombits(exponent<<52 | mantissa)
		case "NegativeBins":
			values[index] = negative[index%len(negative)]
		default:
			panic("unknown bin-reuse corpus")
		}
	}
	return values
}

func BenchmarkSketchBinReuse(b *testing.B) {
	for _, corpus := range append([]string{"Increasing"}, binReuseCorpora...) {
		b.Run(corpus, func(b *testing.B) {
			batchingProcessors(b, 1)
			sketch, _ := benchmarkSketch(b)
			values := binReuseValues("UniqueCycle")
			if corpus != "Increasing" {
				values = binReuseValues(corpus)
			}
			// Warm the store with one corpus, including collapse for the
			// broad holdout. UniqueCycle stresses the cache capacity.
			for _, value := range values {
				if err := sketch.Add(value); err != nil {
					b.Fatal(err)
				}
			}
			index := 0
			before := len(sketch.guest.module.Memory())
			b.ReportAllocs()
			b.ResetTimer()
			for b.Loop() {
				value := values[index&(binReuseCorpusSize-1)]
				if corpus == "Increasing" {
					value = float64(binReuseCorpusSize + index + 1)
				}
				if err := sketch.Add(value); err != nil {
					b.Fatal(err)
				}
				index++
			}
			b.StopTimer()
			batchingMetrics(b, 1, 1, before, len(sketch.guest.module.Memory()))
			if count, err := sketch.Count(); err != nil || count != float64(b.N+len(values)) {
				b.Fatalf("count=%g, want=%d: %v", count, b.N+len(values), err)
			}
		})
	}
}

// This interface is implemented only by the hash-checked diagnostic overlay.
// The committed generated module and its public facade remain unchanged.
type binReuseProbe interface {
	BinReuseOriginalMapping(float64, [4]uint64) int32
	BinReuseCachedMapping(float64, [4]uint64) int32
	BinReuseConfigure(int)
	BinReuseContains(float64, [4]uint64) bool
	BinReuseOccupied(float64) bool
}

func binReuseParameters() [4]uint64 {
	// Exact default constructor stores in the pinned generated module; the
	// diagnostic driver checks that constructor and the entire module hash.
	return [4]uint64{0x3ff0400000000000, 4634239110019182123, 0x0010400000000000, 0x4094ea0000000000}
}

func binReuseReplay(t *testing.T, probe binReuseProbe, values []float64, observed map[uint64]int32, capacity int) {
	t.Helper()
	probe.BinReuseConfigure(capacity)
	parameters := binReuseParameters()
	for replay := range 2 {
		var hits, misses, evictions int
		for index, value := range values {
			if probe.BinReuseContains(value, parameters) {
				hits++
			} else {
				misses++
				if probe.BinReuseOccupied(value) {
					evictions++
				}
			}
			if probe.BinReuseCachedMapping(value, parameters) != observed[math.Float64bits(value)] {
				t.Fatalf("cached mapping differs: capacity=%d replay=%d", capacity, replay)
			}
			if (index+1)%1024 == 0 {
				t.Logf("cache capacity=%d replay=%d phase=%d hits=%d misses=%d collisions/evictions=%d", capacity, replay, index/1024, hits, misses, evictions)
				hits, misses, evictions = 0, 0, 0
			}
		}
	}
}

func TestSketchBinReuseIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	g, _ := newDifferential(t)
	probe, ok := any(g.module).(binReuseProbe)
	if !ok {
		t.Skip("requires the diagnostic overlay")
	}
	parameters := binReuseParameters()
	other, _ := newDifferential(t)
	otherProbe, ok := any(other.module).(binReuseProbe)
	if !ok {
		t.Fatal("inconsistent diagnostic module")
	}
	for _, capacity := range []int{1, 16, 64, 256} {
		probe.BinReuseConfigure(capacity)
		otherProbe.BinReuseConfigure(capacity)
		_ = probe.BinReuseCachedMapping(42, parameters)
		if otherProbe.BinReuseContains(42, parameters) {
			t.Fatal("fresh module shares another module's entries")
		}
		if !probe.BinReuseContains(42, parameters) || probe.BinReuseContains(math.Nextafter(42, 43), parameters) {
			t.Fatal("cache does not compare full value bits")
		}
		for field := range parameters {
			changed := parameters
			changed[field]++
			if probe.BinReuseContains(42, changed) {
				t.Fatalf("mapping field %d absent from cache identity", field)
			}
			if got, want := probe.BinReuseCachedMapping(42, changed), probe.BinReuseOriginalMapping(42, changed); got != want {
				t.Fatalf("mapping parameter change: got=%d want=%d", got, want)
			}
			_ = probe.BinReuseCachedMapping(42, parameters)
		}
		probe.BinReuseConfigure(capacity)
		if probe.BinReuseContains(42, parameters) {
			t.Fatal("reset retained a stale entry")
		}
	}
}

func BenchmarkSketchBinMapping(b *testing.B) {
	for _, mode := range []string{"Original", "OriginalIncreasing", "Hit1", "Miss1", "Hit64", "Miss64"} {
		b.Run(mode, func(b *testing.B) {
			batchingProcessors(b, 1)
			sketch, _ := benchmarkSketch(b)
			probe, ok := any(sketch.guest.module).(binReuseProbe)
			if !ok {
				b.Skip("requires the diagnostic overlay")
			}
			capacity := 1
			if mode == "Hit64" || mode == "Miss64" {
				capacity = 64
			}
			probe.BinReuseConfigure(capacity)
			parameters := binReuseParameters()
			mapValue := probe.BinReuseCachedMapping
			if mode == "Original" || mode == "OriginalIncreasing" {
				mapValue = probe.BinReuseOriginalMapping
			}
			_ = mapValue(42, parameters)
			increasing := mode == "OriginalIncreasing" || mode == "Miss1" || mode == "Miss64"
			index := 0
			var result int32
			b.ReportAllocs()
			b.ResetTimer()
			for b.Loop() {
				value := float64(42)
				if increasing {
					value = float64(index + 1)
				}
				result = mapValue(value, parameters)
				index++
			}
			b.StopTimer()
			if runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0) != 1 {
				b.Fatal("actual processor mismatch")
			}
			b.ReportMetric(1, "actual-procs")
			b.ReportMetric(float64(result), "last-bin")
		})
	}
}

func TestSketchBinReuseCorpora(t *testing.T) {
	g, reference := newDifferential(t)
	limits := g.instanceLimits()
	parameters := binReuseParameters()
	probe, hasProbe := any(g.module).(binReuseProbe)
	for _, corpus := range binReuseCorpora {
		t.Run(corpus, func(t *testing.T) {
			values := binReuseValues(corpus)
			bins := make(map[int64]bool)
			observed := make(map[uint64]int32)
			var previous int64
			adjacent := 0
			for index, value := range values {
				bits := math.Float64bits(value)
				bin, seen := observed[bits]
				if !seen {
					count, encoded := binOracleState(t, reference, limits, []float64{value})
					state := readSingletonSketchBin(t, encoded)
					if count != math.Float64bits(1) || !state.hasBin || state.zeroCount != 0 {
						t.Fatalf("unexpected singleton state for %016x: %+v", bits, state)
					}
					bin = int32(state.index) // #nosec G115 -- The protobuf helper checks the int32 range.
					observed[bits] = bin
				}
				bins[int64(bin)] = true
				if index != 0 && previous == int64(bin) {
					adjacent++
				}
				previous = int64(bin)
				if hasProbe && probe.BinReuseOriginalMapping(value, parameters) != bin {
					t.Fatalf("extracted mapping differs for %016x", bits)
				}
			}
			if corpus == "UniqueCycle" || corpus == "NearbyUniqueCycle" || corpus == "BroadHoldout" {
				if len(observed) != len(values) {
					t.Fatal("unique corpus contains duplicate value bits")
				}
			}
			if corpus == "BroadHoldout" && len(bins) <= 2048 {
				t.Fatal("holdout does not exceed the pinned store capacity")
			}
			t.Logf("locality points=%d distinct-values=%d distinct-bins=%d adjacent-same-bin=%d", len(values), len(observed), len(bins), adjacent)
			if hasProbe {
				for _, capacity := range []int{1, 16, 64, 256} {
					binReuseReplay(t, probe, values, observed, capacity)
				}
			}
			// Ordered full-facade state comparison crosses collapse and then
			// revisits low bins, with both scalar and prevalidated batch calls.
			points := append(append(append([]float64(nil), values...), values...), values[:32]...)
			library := openTest(t, Options{Instances: 1})
			assertBinMathState(t, library, reference, limits, points, false)
			assertBinMathState(t, library, reference, limits, points, true)
		})
	}
}
